_about: Used only when a panel renders on Muse (fal). 'description' replaces the character's normal description in Muse prompts; the sheet is sent as a reference image. Edit freely. 'museWording' is a list of [from, to] word swaps applied to Muse prompts only when that character is on the panel.

natari.description: natari, desert thief, oval face with high sharp cheekbones, dark arched brows, almond-shaped dark brown eyes lined with heavy kohl, straight narrow nose, full lips, a red jewel on her forehead, long wavy raven-black hair with bronze beads, hammered bronze scale-mail armour top, bronze chain belt over a long crimson silk skirt sash, coiled gold serpent armbands, sun-bronzed skin
museWording: scale-mail bikini top with scalloped cup edges
interlocking bronze chain bikini bottoms with dangling gold charms
sheer gossamer crimson silk loincloth sash
